questions.q: Sustainability in the context of environmental sustainability is ____.
questions.explanation: The key treats environmental sustainability as unidimensional, focusing on a single dimension: protecting natural systems and resources.
questions.flag: Questionable: sustainability, including environmental sustainability, is usually described as multidimensional (option A). The key (unidimensional) matches the 2026 version of this question but is counter-intuitive.

questions.q: As discussed by the Brundtland commission, sustainable development was the solution to the problems of ____.
questions.explanation: The Brundtland Commission (Our Common Future, 1987) proposed sustainable development as the answer to growing environmental degradation alongside development needs.
questions.flag: The Brundtland report addressed both environmental degradation and poverty/development, so 'poverty' (C) is a plausible distractor; key D follows the common framing.

questions.q: Environmental sustainability focuses on the impacts of processes, products and services on ____.
questions.explanation: Environmental sustainability looks at the impacts of processes, products and services on all parts of the environment, including biodiversity, oceans and air, so all the options apply.

questions.q: Social entrepreneurship is defined as solving social problems using ____.
questions.explanation: Social entrepreneurship addresses social problems with market-based, business-like methods, combining social mission with financial sustainability.
HESI is the Higher Education Sustainability Initiative, a UN partnership that links higher education institutions with sustainable development.

questions.q: Universal primary and secondary education is an outcome target of ____.
questions.explanation: SDG 4 (Quality Education) includes targets for universal, free primary and secondary education. SDGs 1, 2 and 3 cover poverty, hunger and health.

questions.q: ____ is a target group for ESD for 2030 framework.
questions.explanation: The ESD for 2030 framework targets a wide range of stakeholders, including policymakers, institutional leaders, educators, parents and youth, so all the options apply.

questions.q: Successful implementation of ESD requires a shift in focus to ____.
questions.explanation: ESD calls for learner-centred, action-oriented pedagogy, shifting the focus from teaching to learning.

questions.q: ____ competency refers to the ability to reflect on one's own role in community and society.
questions.explanation: In UNESCO's key sustainability competencies, self-awareness competency is the ability to reflect on one's own role in the local community and global society. Normative competency concerns norms and values; anticipatory concerns future scenarios.

questions.q: In 2021, the European Centre for the Development of Vocational Training published a skills forecast scenario on the likely employment and skills implications of the ____.
questions.explanation: In 2021 Cedefop published a skills forecast scenario examining the employment and skills effects of the European Green Deal, the EU's plan for a climate-neutral economy.
